parole.significato: People of the Book

parole.significato: A teahouse in parts of Central Asia.

parole.significato: A Persian shortsword.

parole.significato: The plant muskroot.

parole.significato: A gathering place for Sufis, especially in the Ottoman Empire and South Asia.
